bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money for an anaerobic digestor energy system.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; ANAEROBIC DIGESTOR ENERGY SYSTEM. +]

[+(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $....... in fiscal year 2025 and $........ in fiscal year 2026 are appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Recycling and Energy, in partnership with Dem-Con HZI Bioenergy, LLC, to construct an anaerobic digestor energy system in Louisville Township. +]

[+(b) For the purposes of this section, "anaerobic digestor energy system" means a facility that uses diverted food and organic waste to create renewable natural gas and biochar. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money for an anaerobic digestor energy system.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; ANAEROBIC DIGESTOR ENERGY SYSTEM.

(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $....... in fiscal year 2025 and $........ in fiscal year 2026 are appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Recycling and Energy, in partnership with Dem-Con HZI Bioenergy, LLC, to construct an anaerobic digestor energy system in Louisville Township.

(b) For the purposes of this section, "anaerobic digestor energy system" means a facility that uses diverted food and organic waste to create renewable natural gas and biochar.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: (a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $....... in fiscal year 2025 and $........ in fiscal year 2026 are appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Recycling and Energy, in partnership with Dem-Con HZI Bioenergy, LLC, to construct an anaerobic digestor energy system in Louisville Township.
(b) For the purposes of this section, "anaerobic digestor energy system" means a facility that uses diverted food and organic waste to create renewable natural gas and biochar.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
